# IAIS Acoustic Emission Testing

Official site: https://www.acousticemissiontesting.org
IAIS India: https://iaisindia.com/
IAIS UAE: https://iaisuae.com/

This site explains possible AET applications and project-scoping factors. Application examples are general technical information, not claims of completed IAIS AET projects or guaranteed detection.
